turnos.t: How does a grand vision turn into what staff do on Monday morning?
Through levels of objectives. At the top sit the vision and mission. Below them, strategic objectives: long-term goals for the whole organization, like entering Asia within five years.

Tactical objectives: shorter-term goals for departments, about a year, like raising online sales by ten percent this year. They help achieve the strategy. And at the base, operational objectives for teams, day to day.
